section_header: A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL
title: REMOVE MANUAL VALVE LEVER SHAFT
ocr_text:
AT-17

A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

21. REMOVE MANUAL VALVE LEVER SHAFT
(a) Using a hammer and a chisel, cut off the spacer and remove it from the shaft.

Y_003908

(b) Using a pin punch, drive out the spring pin.
HINT: Slowly drive out the spring pin so it does not fall into the transmission case.
(c) Pull the manual valve lever shaft out through the case and remove the manual valve lever.

AT5105

(d) Using a screwdriver, remove the oil seal.

Y_003909

22. REMOVE OIL PUMP
(a) Remove the 7 bolts holding the oil pump to the transmission case.

AT5122

(b) Using SST, remove the oil pump.
SST 09350-30020 (09350-07020)

SST

AT5123
